entry:kr-ai:cov:eval.note: Risk management measures for high-impact AI (Art. 34(1)1) and lifecycle risk identification, assessment and mitigation for high-compute AI (Art. 32(1)1) support 'provider-led evaluations'. Art. 34 measures aim at safety and trustworthiness and include explanation (transparency); neither Art. 32 nor Art. 34 mentions fairness. Strictly, Art. 32 requires a risk management system (위험관리체계), not a 'plan'. 'Less prescriptive than the EU AI Act on methodology' is comparative.

text:layer-1:tooltip.note: Internal: compared each text with RUBRIC §2 and the entries the map puts in each layer at 1cc3fdc. L1 (aisr, aisi-net, ai-summits, oecd, coe-ai, unesco, un-ai): norms, a treaty, summits, the network of national bodies; no entry imposes direct duties on labs. L2: statutes, EOs, framework acts plus a CAC regulation, proposed bills and a planning item; the tooltip omits regulations, proposals and the US AI Action Plan (a policy plan, pow 2), an incompleteness rather than an error (us-action's layer is outside this group). Pending P-0172/P-0197 (new L4 standards entries) would not make the L4 text wrong.
